meta.title: Kite codex
meta.description: Every airframe in Layangin, with the aerodynamic numbers behind it: sail area, mass, lift and drag coefficients, tail drag and handling.

header.title: The rack
header.lead: Eight airframes. The shape is the stat sheet — sail area, mass and tail drag are what make one kite steady and another quick.

tooltip.area: Larger sails generate more lift and more drag. Both scale with area.
tooltip.mass: Heavier kites resist gusts but sink faster in light wind.
tooltip.lift: Peak lift coefficient of the sail. Higher means more pull for the same wind.
tooltip.drag: Baseline resistance through the air, before tails.
tooltip.tailDrag: Extra drag from the tails. High tail drag means very stable and slow to steer.
tooltip.agility: How quickly the sail answers your steering.
tooltip.stability: How strongly the kite returns to trim after being upset.
tooltip.lineStrength: How well the line resists being worn through.
tooltip.cutPower: How fast this rig wears through the other line.

pecut.name: Pecut
pecut.lore: The plain fighting diamond. Two bamboo spars, a paper sail, and nothing else — the kite almost everyone learns on, and still a fair fight in the right hands.

delta.name: Delta
delta.lore: A modern triangle with a keel instead of a tail. Very quick to the crossing and very quick to over-rotate; there is no tail to save you.

bebean.name: Bebean
bebean.lore: The Balinese fish. A broad sail that hangs on in light air and simply will not come down, at the cost of answering the line slowly.

kotak.name: Box kite
kotak.lore: Two cells and no tail at all. The steadiest thing in the sky and the hardest to steer — it wins by outlasting, not by cutting.

sawangan.name: Sawangan
sawangan.lore: The big bowed kite with a humming bow across the top. You hear it before you see it. Heavy, relentless, and hard on your own arms.

elang.name: Elang
elang.lore: Swept wings and a sharp edge. Fast, light and unforgiving — it bites hard but has little line to spare if the exchange goes the wrong way.

janggan.name: Janggan
janggan.lore: The Balinese dragon: a small crowned sail dragging a tail many times its own length. The tail is the kite. Nothing upsets it, and nothing hurries it.

naga.name: Naga Senja
naga.lore: The dusk dragon's own rig, jagged and triple-tailed. The best of everything on the rack, and priced accordingly.

picker.title: Pick your kite
picker.note: Each cell is one airframe wearing one livery. Buy airframes and liveries in the shop; the colourway applies to all of them.
